basics.name: Margaret E. B. Webb
basics.summary: Postdoctoral Associate in Disciplinary-Based Education Research with expertise in systems thinking, identity, motivation, and learning theory as applied to STEM graduate education. Research focuses on how institutional structures, disciplinary cultures, and funding mechanisms impact faculty and student development, interdisciplinary collaboration, and engineering education ecosystems.
